subject.title: [Feature]: Add editable voice dictation to the Control UI composer

question: Should OpenClaw core accept Gateway/provider-backed editable Control UI composer dictation now, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 as the canonical implementation path?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested workflow, but adding it changes a security- and provider-sensitive web/Gateway boundary and already has an open implementation candidate that needs maintainer direction rather than a parallel repair lane.

options.title: Sponsor the linked Gateway path
options.body: Keep this issue open and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 as the canonical implementation after proof and security/accessibility concerns are resolved.

options.title: Defer core dictation
options.body: Leave composer dictation out of core for now and close or park the linked PR if the product/security boundary is not worth adding.

options.title: Fold into broader voice routing
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45508 as the broader canonical direction if maintainers want one provider-backed WebChat STT/TTS plan before a composer-specific feature lands.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the linked Gateway path
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 as the canonical implementation after proof and security/accessibility concerns are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the prior merged server-side WebChat dictation work and is the strongest history signal for the Gateway/provider-backed approach.
